from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metadata for a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as identified")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or cause of dispute stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed data for the current document input."""
    case_documents: list[CaseDocument]
